The Ballistics damage bonus applies only to ballista, catapults and ranged automaton weapons, so damage_bonus is 0 and damage_bonus_applies_to is 'none'. Templates: the caste column is folded into the name, keeping the printed nested parentheses. Book notes say the Personal Automaton (first equipment item) and the 'Craft (x) 3' entry are italicized, meaning they come from class powers (Crafting = 3 ranks of Craft), not proficiency picks; 'Craft (x) 3' is kept as printed. The book says the player may choose the Clockworker's proficiency and the Contraption's mechanical ability, and may swap crafter's tools for thieves' tools. In the markdown, 'dwarven honey-mead' was pushed into the Mechanic row by a table wrap; it was moved back to the end of the Apothecary equipment. War Machinist lists machinist's tools twice (as printed). No (enc.) values are given in this book, so book_encumbrance is null. Requirement CON 9 is the dwarven racial requirement.

transcription_notes: Level table extra columns (L1-10): Loremastery 15+,14+,13+,12+,11+,10+,9+,8+,7+,6+; Rhetoric 8+,7+,6+,5+,4+,3+,2+,2+,2+,2+. Rhetorical effects: Anaphora (hypnotism), Derision (infuriate person), Epizeuxis (sleep), Innuendo (incite madness), Pleonasm (ensorcellment), Procatalepsis (charm person); +2 effects at 4th and 8th. Later powers: Tireless (6th), Renown (9th), Rule of Law (10th). CON is both a prime requisite and the listed requirement (CON 9, the dwarven racial requirement); kept in requirements because the book prints it. Templates: the caste column is folded into the name, keeping the printed nested parentheses. IMPORTANT: the last two entries in each template's proficiencies (Derision, Pleonasm, Epizeuxis, Anaphora, Innuendo, Procatalepsis) are the template's two starting rhetorical effects (italic in the book), not proficiencies; they were kept in the list as printed. Alchemy (Assessor) and Manual of Arms (Marshal) are not on the rhetor class list, so they are presumably general proficiencies. No (enc.) values given; book_encumbrance null.

transcription_notes: Damage bonus taken from the level table (+1 at 1st, +2 3rd, +3 6th, +4 9th, +5 12th), which matches the prose; it applies to both missile and melee attacks. The weapon list says 'hammers' and 'war hammers'; both map to warhammer. The list covers every axe and bludgeon, but the specific weapons are listed rather than categories. Purified Soul's 'dagger' is not on the weapon list (as printed). Later powers: Battlefield Prowess and Stalwart Soul (5th), Rite of Discovery (7th), Greater Rite of Sealing and Renown (9th). Templates: the caste column is folded into the name, keeping the printed nested parentheses. A markdown table glitch put 'late' (from the 'Template' header) before 'Fallen Hero' and 'ent' (from 'Equipment') before its equipment; both were removed. 'tinder box' (Crusader) is as printed. 'Manual of Arms 2' is presumably 2 ranks, but the class already has 1 rank from its Manual of Arms power, so this may mean the total. Theology and Siege Engineering are not on the class list, so they are presumably general proficiencies. No (enc.) values given; book_encumbrance null.
